Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision during a lane change, reporting neck
pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical whiplash. The mechanism and
force of impact are considered well matched to the reported injury. Over the course of
14 visits, care included manual therapy, targeted exercise, and home stretching,
following a typical recovery pattern with visit frequency tapering as symptoms
improved. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle
tenderness that support the clinical picture, while several neurological and
orthopedic screening tests returned normal results. Review of the record also shows
prior treatment for the same cervical region within the past two years, and that
earlier condition is judged to contribute to some of the current complaints and should
be considered when assessing residual symptoms. Two billing entries for the same date
of service are currently under review for accuracy. Prognosis is good with continued
home exercise, and the patient is expected to reach maximum improvement with routine
follow-up as needed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
